description: Implement rule-based classification of the task description into one of five types. answer: question words (why, what, how, explain) with no action verbs. modify_existing_pr: action verbs (fix, change, update, add) on a PR source. implement_issue: action verbs on an issue source. clarify: insufficient context to determine intent. ignore: reserved keywords that are not real invocations. Classification gates capability grants — a read-only answer task must not receive worktree or push permissions.
title: Rule-based task classifier (answer / modify_existing_pr / implement_issue / clarify / ignore)
